title: VectorForge adds regional processing controls
content: VectorForge announced regional processing controls for customers in the European Union. The company said that the feature is available now.

title: VectorForge publishes inference cost report
content: The company reported a 22 percent reduction in average inference cost for a selected customer group. The report did not include all customers.

title: LumenOps releases multilingual review tools
content: LumenOps released support review tools for Spanish, French, and German conversations.

title: LumenOps appoints a finance lead
content: LumenOps appointed Erin Moss as vice president of finance. The company said that she will lead funding preparation.

title: Kestrel Health joins research software program
content: Kestrel Health joined a software evaluation program at Beacon Research Hospital. The announcement did not mention the FDA or a regulatory pilot.

title: Atlas Grid expands an Ohio installation
content: Atlas Grid expanded its defect detection system from one production line to three lines at an Ohio plant.

title: Cedar Robotics starts a regional warehouse trial
content: Cedar Robotics started a trial with a regional parts distributor. The announcement did not state the contract value.

title: Prism Legal adds contract approval controls
content: Prism Legal released approval controls for contract changes. The feature keeps an audit record for each approval.

title: SageBio starts three design partnerships
content: SageBio started design partnerships with three small biotechnology companies. The announcement did not describe payment terms.

title: QuantaLedger adds evidence export
content: QuantaLedger released an evidence export for external audit teams. The export supports common accounting workbooks.

title: RelayWorks signs a regional service company
content: RelayWorks signed a regional heating service company. The customer has 85 field technicians.

title: Northstar Security opens its private beta
content: Northstar Security opened a private beta for small security teams. The announcement did not include customer or revenue information.
